etimad.title: دراسة شاملة لأعمال السلامة والحماية من الحريق لمواقع مباني وحدات منطقة الطائف
etimad.note: Royal Saudi Land Forces: full fire-protection and safety study of unit buildings in Taif. Matches SLFE's fire protection discipline and is a defense client.

etimad.title: تقديم الخدمات الإشرافية والاستشارية والهندسية لمقر المركز الصناعي الجديد
etimad.note: Supervision, consultancy and engineering services for the National Industrial Development Center's new HQ.

etimad.title: دراسة وتقييم الجاهزية التشغيلية للأنظمة الكهروميكانيكية بروضة خريم
etimad.note: Study and assessment of the operational readiness of electromechanical systems at Rawdat Khuraim.

etimad.title: تحديث نظام التحكم الآلي بمحطات منطقتي نجران والباحة (الصفا -الوجيد -عرده- ثراد- الجنابين)
etimad.note: Upgrade of the automatic control systems at five water stations in Najran and Al-Baha. Likely a design-and-install contract, so check the booklet for the engineering share.

etimad.title: تقديم الخدمات الهندسية (حزمة التخطيط التنظيمي والرفع المساحي) وفق اتفاقية إطارية مفتوحة
etimad.note: Open framework agreement for engineering services (zoning plans and surveying) for State Properties. Planning and survey work is outside SLFE's core disciplines.

etimad.title: عملية خدمة الاستشارات الفنية لبناء نطاق العمل المطلوب بمعهد الدراسات الفنية للقوات البحرية بالدمام
etimad.note: Royal Saudi Naval Forces, Dammam: technical consultancy to write the scope of work for the Naval Technical Studies Institute. Defense client close to SLFE's Khobar base.

etimad.title: إعادة تصميم المقر الجديد للمركز الوطني للتنمية الصناعية 2027
etimad.note: Redesign of the NIDC's new HQ (architecture and building services). Sister tender to the supervision package.

watch.title: GAMI governor visits HCIS headquarters; oversight of military factories reviewed
watch.detail: The visit covered HCIS's work on security, safety and fire protection at the facilities it oversees, including military factories, its Marqab operations centre and the unified industrial security platform.
watch.slfe: Security and fire-protection design for GAMI-licensed plants has to pass HCIS review. This is SLFE's Communication/Industrial Security and Fire Protection disciplines.

watch.title: HCIS updated Regulatory Security Instructions (SRI)
watch.detail: Applies to every entity under HCIS supervision: stronger admin frameworks for security networks, clearer job-level requirements, training. HCIS runs workshops and periodic compliance evaluations.
watch.slfe: Client facilities SLFE designs for are audited against the SRI. Check the security-staffing and network assumptions in new designs.

watch.title: HCIS SEC (security) and SAF (safety & fire) directives
watch.detail: The baseline directives for industrial facilities under HCIS: perimeter, access control, CCTV and communications (SEC), and safety and fire protection (SAF).
watch.slfe: Design basis for SLFE's industrial-security and fire-protection deliverables on Aramco, SEC-utility and petrochemical projects.

watch.title: Military spending localization reached 27.30% in 2025
watch.detail: Up from 24.89% in 2024. Local content is 40.91% of military spending, and the sector added SAR 7.468 bn to GDP. The 2030 target is above 50%. Four financing MoUs were signed with Saudi banks at the Military Industries Forum in Riyadh.
watch.slfe: Every point of localization means more in-Kingdom plants, test ranges and depots that need design, PMC and HCIS-compliant engineering.

watch.title: GAMI: almost 80% of military industry is dual-use
watch.detail: Acting Governor Bandar Alkhorayef said GAMI's localization policy sets what international contractors must localize on each programme, coordinated with the end user and the regulator.
watch.slfe: Dual-use means oil & gas and industrial engineering skills carry over. That supports SLFE as a local engineering partner to OEMs.

watch.title: Military Industries Marketplace (MIM)
watch.detail: GAMI's platform where licensed or registered investors see published localization opportunities and connect with international OEMs.
watch.slfe: Register SLFE as a service provider to see opportunities and OEM requests for local engineering.

watch.title: SAMI Land Industrial Complex and two new SAMI companies
watch.detail: 82,000 m² complex inside a 1 million m² industrial area, for building, testing and sustaining wheeled and tracked armoured vehicles. Up to 1,500 vehicles a year and 1,000+ Saudi jobs. SAMI Land and SAMI Autonomous were launched.
watch.slfe: Large sustainment and test facilities need utilities, fire protection, security systems and supervision.

watch.title: SAMI RUKN local content programme
watch.detail: Suppliers register on the RUKN platform, then go through a capability assessment, classification, a development plan and onboarding into SAMI's approved sourcing channels.
watch.slfe: The route to SAMI's approved supplier list. Its page doesn't say whether engineering services are a category, so ask when registering.

watch.title: World Defense Show 2028, Riyadh
watch.detail: Fourth edition, founded by GAMI. WDS 2026 had 1,486 exhibitors from 89 countries and $8.8 bn in orders and announcements. Programme details are expected from early 2027.
watch.slfe: The main place to meet OEMs that need local engineering partners. Exact days aren't announced yet.

watch.title: Aramco iktva hit 70% local content; new target 75% by 2030
watch.detail: More than 200 localization opportunities in 12 sectors (about $28 bn a year), 47 strategic products made in the Kingdom for the first time, and 350+ investments in new plants.
watch.slfe: SLFE is an Aramco GES+ contractor, so its iktva score counts in Aramco awards. New local plants also need design and PMC.

watch.title: iktva Forum & Exhibition 2027, Dhahran Expo
watch.slfe: Meet Aramco procurement and new local manufacturers who need engineering.

watch.title: Future Minerals Forum 2027, Riyadh (KAICC)
watch.detail: Mining and minerals value chain forum.
watch.slfe: Processing plants and logistics hubs for the minerals value chain.

watch.title: Global Logistics Forum, Riyadh — moved to 16–18 Nov 2027
watch.detail: The second edition was postponed from 29 Nov–1 Dec 2026, according to the forum's official X account on 8 Nov 2026.
watch.slfe: Ministry of Transport logistics zones and corridors: planning and design work.
